prompt: Our agenda importer pulls the same conference program from two calendar sources, and a panel session that appears in each source shows up twice in the merged agenda. I traced it into src/agenda-fingerprint.mjs: bookingFingerprint returns one identifier when a source supplies the room before the host, and a different identifier when the other source supplies the host before the room, so the merge step can't tell the two entries describe the same session. The regression test in tests/agenda-fingerprint.test.mjs reproduces it: `npm test` fails right now and should pass once this is fixed.
